title: Oakland, Club Plantation and Ellington's Jump for Joy
summary: The Hines band plays Sweet's Ballroom and a Los Angeles club while Ellington's Jump for Joy is in town.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Any way, we finally got into San Diego and we played and then we went into Oakland, California, and we played at a place called Sweets Ballroom. Well, in the meantime Charlie Barnett came through there and he played at Sweets, and Lena Horne was the vocalist in the band at that time.

So now when we got out to California in 1940 we played at a place called Club Plantation, which is way out in Watts, you know, right straight out Central Avenue, right around into Watts. And in the show we had -- Sarah Vaughn was in the band too.

No, no, wait a minute, no. She was in the band, but I mean I was a little bit ahead of myself. This wasn't Watts. We played at next door to this hotel, what was the name of this club? I'll think of it.
Any way we played this club and Duke Ellington at that time was out there, and Orson Welles and all of them were behind him, and they were producing 'jump for joy.'
